property_summary: For every caller and every nonzero ETH amount sent to C via its receive, the reference contract's receive always accepts the payment (call succeeds) and thus returns true from a try/catch wrapper; the mutant's receive that has require(false) will cause the call to revert for some inputs (any positive amount), breaking this rule.
change_summary: Replace the require condition so it always reverts (false), making the receive revert on every call.
